Oil fell 7.6% in a single day. Brent crude settled at $104.77 a barrel on Monday, November 2, down $8.66, CNBC reports.

It was oil's biggest one-day drop since July, on hopes of US-Iran peace talks: Washington said it would prefer a peaceful end to the conflict and Iran signaled it is open to talks. For drivers, the AAA US gasoline average was still $4.17 a gallon on November 2, up from $3.04 a year ago, about 37% more. By Tuesday, November 3, Brent was edging back up above $105. Prices as of the November 2 settle.
